en.hubeali: Humeyd Bin Ziyad, from Al Hassan Bin Muhammad Bin Sama’at, from Wuheyb Bin Hafs, from Abu Baseer who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> about the man forsakes his relatives, from the ones who do not recognise the Truth. He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘It is not befitting for him that he abandon them’.
en.sarwar: 3. Hamid ibn Ziyad has narrated from al-Hassan ibn Muhammad ibn Sama’a from Wuhayb ibn Hafs from abu Basir who has said the following: “
Once I asked abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) about a man who has forsaken his relatives who do not recognize the truth.’ The Imam said, ‘It is not proper for him to abandon them.’”
